from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyOperatingProfit(BaseModel):
    """Extracted operating profit data from a single company's financial report."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The full name of the company as reported in the document")
    security_code: str | None = Field(description="The stock market security code of the company, e.g., '002676'")
    operating_profit_value: float | None = Field(description="The numerical value of the Operating Profit")
    currency: str | None = Field(description="The currency unit of the reported value, e.g., '元'")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period, e.g., '2024年第一季度'")
    source_quote: str | None = Field(description="A short verbatim excerpt from the document supporting the extraction")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_operating_profits: list[CompanyOperatingProfit]
